resampling: QCD and resonant jets each resampled with replacement once per replica, the same indices for every run
test: pass = |delta| > 3 sigma, sigma^2 = run_sd^2 + boot_sd^2, run_sd = run-to-run SD of the paired differences, boot_sd = bootstrap SD of the mean paired difference; pass_run_se uses run_se = run_sd / sqrt(n_pairs) in place of run_sd
test_l3: l3: the sides unpaired over all their runs, pass = |delta| > 3 sigma, sigma^2 = sd_config^2 + sd_reference^2 + boot_sd^2 (decision L3, 2026-11-13)
